reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Get a message before warranties expire. Each reminder is sent once. Uses <link>Shoutrrr URLs</link> for ntfy, Gotify, Discord, Telegram, email, Pushover and more.

reminders.urlsHint: One per line, e.g. ntfy://ntfy.sh/my-topic or smtp://user:pass@host:587/?to=me@example.com
reminders.schedule: Checked daily in the server's timezone ({{timezone}}).
